title: Austin Growth: US 183, Land & Personnel Talks
summary:
*   City officials met in a private executive session to discuss sensitive legal, land, and personnel matters.
*   Key discussions involved acquiring land for the US 183 highway expansion project and a related drainage improvement along Angus Valley Channel.
*   Personnel policies and legal advice concerning unspecified "Tank Farm issues" were also on the agenda.
*   No final public actions or policy decisions were made during this meeting.
